profile.name: Picomotor 微位移电机控制器
profile.description: 这是一种用于驱动和控制 Picomotor 微位移执行器的运动控制器，通常通过 USB 与计算机连接。它常用于实验室中的精密光学调整、镜架或平台的微小位移调节，以及需要高分辨率机械定位的场景。
profile.description_en: This is a motion controller for driving and controlling Picomotor micro-positioning actuators, typically connected to a computer via USB. It is commonly used in laboratories for fine optical alignment, small displacement adjustment of mounts or stages, and other applications requiring high-resolution mechanical positioning.
